title: I Can't Decide
lyrics:
[00:00.16]It's not easy having yourself a good time
[00:07.51]Greasing up those bets and betters
[00:10.06]Watching out they don't four-letter
[00:12.36]Fuck and kiss you both at the same time
[00:17.26]Smells like something I've forgotten
[00:19.91]Curled up, died and now it's rotten
[00:22.71]I'm not a gangster tonight
[00:25.16]Don't wanna be a bad guy
[00:27.66]I'm just a loner, baby
[00:30.11]And now you've gotten in my way
[00:32.91]I can't decide whether you should live or die
[00:37.25]Oh, you'll probably go to Heaven
[00:39.71]Please don't hang your head and cry
[00:41.86]No wonder why my heart feels dead inside
[00:45.16]It's cold and hard and petrified
[00:47.71]Lock the doors and close the blinds
[00:49.92]We're going for a ride
[00:56.41]It's a bitch convincing people to like you
[01:02.45]If I stop now call me a quitter
[01:04.96]If lies were cats you'd be a litter
[01:07.51]Pleasing everyone isn't like you
[01:12.46]Dancing jigs until I'm crippled
[01:14.91]Slug ten drinks, I won't get pickled
[01:17.76]I've got to hand it to you
[01:20.21]You've played by all the same rules
[01:22.72]It takes the truth to fool me
[01:25.21]And now you've made me angry
[01:27.96]I can't decide whether you should live or die
[01:32.28]Oh, you'll probably go to Heaven
[01:34.78]Please don't hang your head and cry
[01:36.91]No wonder why my heart feels dead inside
[01:40.26]It's cold and hard and petrified
[01:42.76]Lock the doors and close the blinds
[01:45.01]We're going for a ride
[01:46.91]Oh, I could throw you in the lake
[01:49.36]Or feed you poisoned birthday cake
[01:51.76]I won't deny I'm gonna miss you when you're gone
[01:56.81]Oh, I could bury you alive
[01:59.31]But you might crawl out with a knife
[02:01.69]And kill me when I'm sleeping, that's why
[02:05.11]I can't decide whether you should live or die
[02:09.46]Oh, you'll probably go to Heaven
[02:11.91]Please don't hang your head and cry
[02:14.01]No wonder why my heart feels dead inside
[02:17.33]It's cold and hard and petrified
[02:19.91]Lock the doors and close the blinds
[02:22.13]We're going for a ride
